new_jobs.title: Merchant Operations Manager, Offers Product & Affordability
new_jobs.jd: **About The Role** Uber Eats is looking for a Merchant Operations Manager to join the Merchant Growth & Affordability team in Taiwan. In this role, you will help merchant partners grow **through effective Offers products while improving the affordability and competitiveness of our marketplace.** Your scope will focus approximately 60% on serving as Taiwan’s Offers product champion and 40% on MPI and affordability strategy. As the Offers product champion, you will bridge Global and Regional Product teams with local business teams, translating merchant needs into product feedback and driving go-to-market planning, experimentation, adoption, and ongoing product improvements. On affordability, you will analyze menu price inflation (MPI), identify opportunities to improve price competitiveness, and develop initiatives that balance consumer value, merchant economics, and business sustainability. This role combines analytical problem-solving, product operations, and cross-functional program management. You will work closely with Account Management, Consumer Operations, Commercial Operations, Finance, Legal, and Global and Regional Product teams to turn insights into measurable business outcomes. **What You Will Be Doing In Role** **Offers Product Championship — approximately 60%** * Act as Taiwan’s Offers product champion: Serve as the local point of contact for Global and Regional Product teams. Consolidate merchant and internal stakeholder feedback, identify local use cases, and translate business needs into actionable product recommendations. * Drive product go-to-market and adoption: Own local launch planning and operational readiness for Offers products and features, including stakeholder alignment, merchant targeting, internal communications, training, and operational playbooks. * Lead experimentation and rollout: Partner with Product, Analytics, and local teams to define hypotheses, success metrics, and execution plans. Coordinate pilots and experiments, evaluate results, and recommend whether and how to scale. * Monitor and improve product performance: Track adoption, usage, and business impact; identify friction points and growth opportunities; and coordinate product issue escalations and resolution with relevant teams. * Connect product capabilities with commercial priorities: Partner with Offers Strategy and Account Management teams to ensure product launches and improvements support merchant needs and local growth objectives. **MPI & Affordability Strategy — approximately 40%** * Develop actionable affordability insights: Analyze MPI, merchant pricing behavior, and marketplace trends to identify the drivers of price gaps and prioritize opportunities by merchant segment and potential business impact. * Develop and operationalize affordability initiatives: Build recommendations and coordinate prioritized initiatives, including In-Store Price (ISP) pilots and related pricing programs, with clear objectives, milestones, and measurement plans. * Evaluate commercial trade-offs: Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to assess the expected impact of affordability initiatives on consumer value, merchant economics, and platform profitability. * Build performance tracking and recommendations: Use SQL, analytical models, and dashboards to monitor key metrics, evaluate initiative effectiveness, and translate findings into clear recommendations for stakeholders and leadership. **The Basic Qualifications You’ll Bring** * Relevant experience: Minimum 3 years of professional experience in operations, product operations, strategy, analytics, or project management. * GTM & Project Autonomy: Demonstrated capability to design, launch, and optimize high-impact GTM strategies or complex cross-functional programs from ideation to execution with complete autonomy. * Stakeholder management: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align local and international stakeholders and influence without direct authority. * Analytical problem-solving: Ability to structure ambiguous business problems, analyze complex data, size opportunities, and translate findings into practical recommendations. Proficiency in SQL and Excel or Google Sheets. * Project ownership and execution: Demonstrated ability to manage projects from planning through execution and measurement, coordinate dependencies, and prioritize across multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment. * Commercial Acumen & P&L Understanding: Strong grasp of business financials, revenue operations, or P&L governance, with the ability to translate technical data analysis into actionable commercial recommendations. * Language proficiency: Fluency in written and spoken English and Mandarin. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in product operations, product launches, or go-to-market planning, particularly in partnership with regional or global Product teams. * Experience in eCommerce, marketplace platforms, food delivery, retail technology, or other high-growth operating environments. * Experience designing and evaluating experiments, A/B tests, or incrementality studies. * Familiarity with pricing, promotions, merchant economics, or affordability initiatives. * Experience building financial or performance models and dashboards using tools such as Tableau or Looker. * Experience developing sales enablement materials, operational playbooks, or scalable processes for merchant-facing teams. **Ready to Ride?** This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you. You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits. Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements. Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing this form.

new_jobs.jd: Wonders.ai is seeking an exceptional operations leader to own and scale the operations of darlin™ (www.darlin.ai). Join our 10–15-person AI startup in a hands-on leadership role working directly with the founder to drive launches, community operations, customer experience, and organizational execution. We seek someone with exceptional execution, strong judgment, and relentless attention to detail. You must independently identify problems, build solutions, and ensure results—not simply coordinate meetings, track tasks, or report progress. Responsibilities 1. Launch Operations: Own product launch planning, operational readiness, communication, incident escalation, and post-launch reviews. 2. Community & Customer Support: Lead Japan, Taiwan, and global community operations; build support workflows, FAQs, escalation systems, and feedback reporting. 3. Release Coordination: Organize testing, verify user-facing flows, coordinate fixes, and escalate release risks with product and engineering teams. 4. Marketing & Growth: Execute campaigns, creator/IP collaborations, events, community growth, and user acquisition initiatives. 5. Campaign Execution: Manage crowdfunding, pre-orders, promotional launches, and related operational planning when required. 6. Operational Systems: Establish SOPs, accountability systems, task tracking, performance metrics, and efficient internal workflows. 7. Team Leadership: Guide 0–3 operations/support staff as assigned, establish standards, and improve team performance. Requirements • Proven experience leading product launches, operations, or growth campaigns. • Exceptional execution, organization, and independent problem-solving. • Hands-on community management, customer support, and operational experience. • Strong user empathy, product awareness, and attention to detail. • Experience creating SOPs, tracking KPIs, and managing cross-functional deliverables. • Chinese and English required; Japanese strongly preferred. • Interest in anime, gaming, AI characters, and Japanese entertainment. • Ability to contribute immediately and take ownership within one month. +++++ We seek a hands-on operations leader who takes ownership, solves problems without waiting for instructions, and ensures important work actually gets completed. A high-impact core team position with competitive compensation and long-term growth opportunities! +++++ Preferred Qualifications • Experience launching consumer apps, games, AI products, creator products, entertainment products, or hardware/software products. • Experience with Japanese communities, anime/game users, fandom-driven products, Discord, X/Twitter, YouTube, or creator channels. • Experience running crowdfunding, pre-order, beta launch, or public waitlist campaigns. • Experience building customer support systems from zero. • Experience using Notion, Slack, Discord, Google Sheets, GitHub/Jira/Linear, analytics tools, CRM tools, or support-ticket systems. Chinese and English required; Japanese strongly preferred. No upfront equity. Long-term upside may be considered later based on contribution, results, and company stage.

new_jobs.title: Senior / Staff Robotics AI/ML Engineer
new_jobs.jd: **Company Description** Genabot is a U.S.-based AI robotics company creating intelligent automation solutions for semiconductor manufacturing and industrial applications. The company combines expertise in artificial intelligence, robotics, advanced sensing, and precision engineering to solve real-world challenges in industrial inspection, maintenance, and automation. With operations in the United States and Taiwan, Genabot leverages Taiwan’s leading semiconductor and manufacturing ecosystem to accelerate next-generation robotic innovation. Team members work on practical AI-powered robotics designed to make industrial operations smarter, safer, and more efficient, from concept through commercialization. **Role Description** The Senior / Staff Robotics AI/ML Engineer is a full-time, on-site role based in Taipei. This role focuses on designing, implementing, and optimizing AI/ML algorithms for robotic systems used in semiconductor manufacturing and industrial automation. Day-to-day responsibilities include building and training models for perception, pattern recognition, and decision-making, integrating ML components with robotic hardware and control systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams on system architecture and product requirements. The engineer will prototype and evaluate algorithms using real-world industrial data, improve performance and robustness under diverse operating conditions, and support deployment and maintenance of AI-enabled robotic solutions in production environments. The role also involves mentoring team members, contributing to technical roadmaps, and staying current with advances in robotics, machine learning, and industrial automation. **Qualifications** * Strong foundation in Computer Science and Algorithms, with experience designing efficient solutions for real-time or resource-constrained systems. * Proficiency in Pattern Recognition and Statistics for developing, analyzing, and optimizing AI/ML models used in industrial inspection and automation. * Hands-on experience with Neural Networks and modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow) for perception, control, or decision-making in robotic systems. * Advanced programming skills in languages such as Python and C++ and familiarity with robotics frameworks (e.g., ROS, ROS2) and embedded or real-time systems. * Experience in robotics, control, or autonomous systems, ideally in semiconductor manufacturing, industrial automation, or related domains. * Ability to design and conduct experiments, work with large sensor and image datasets, and evaluate model performance using robust metrics. * Collaborative mindset with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary, international environment. * Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; prior senior or staff-level experience is highly valued. * Fluency in English; proficiency in Mandarin is a plus for collaborating with local partners and customers.

new_jobs.jd: Google welcomes people with disabilities. **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 10 years of experience with cloud-native architecture in a customer-facing or support role, with application development and integration. * Experience with search systems including retrieval, ranking, and search quality tuning. * Experience with presenting to technical stakeholders and executive leaders. * Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers. * Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like RAG, Text-to-SQL, and semantic search. **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with functional evaluation metrics used to assess model quality and agent quality. * Experience with iPaaS, API gateways, or enterprise service buses (ESBs) in a cloud environment. * Experience developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, semantic kernel, or the Google AI agent development kit (ADK). * Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications. * Knowledge of application integration governance and security, including OAuth2 flows and short-lived credential management. * Understanding of integration patterns using OpenAPI and model context protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and API gateways. **About the job** The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners. In this role, you will partner with technical business teams to differentiate Google Cloud to the customers. You will serve as the technical authority on integrating Generative Artificial Intelligence (AI) into enterprise environments, moving beyond simple chat interfaces to architecting secure and data-connected solutions. You will engage with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and present solutions on Google Cloud. You will blend market knowledge and technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud AI portfolio.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems. **Responsibilities** * Combine business strategies with direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts. * Provide technical consultation to customers on enterprise AI integration patterns, act as a technical advisor and build customer relationships. * Work with Google Cloud products to demonstrate and prototype integrations in customer and partner environments. Work within Product and Engineering management systems to document, prioritize, and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues. * Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as needed, and act as a public advocate for Google Cloud. * Drive the technical win for workloads within Gemini Enterprise to ensure adoption, support the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp, recommend integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms, and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution on Google Cloud. new_jobs.jd: **職缺介紹** 我們的客戶為全球電子科技品牌企業，目前招募具備國際品牌行銷、B2B 科技產品推廣及大型行銷團隊管理經驗的資深主管，負責制定全球行銷策略、品牌定位及市場推廣方向。 **工作內容** 1. 制定公司整體行銷策略、年度計畫及行銷預算。 2. 依據全球市場趨勢、產業發展及公司營運目標，規劃品牌及市場策略。 3. 建立行銷 KPI，追蹤執行成效並持續優化。 4. 負責企業品牌定位、品牌形象及全球市場溝通策略。 5. 執行市場、競爭對手及客戶需求分析。 6. 推動品牌知名度、市場影響力及客戶認知提升。 7. 規劃數位行銷、SEO、SEM、EDM、社群媒體、網站及內容行銷策略。 8. 透過數據分析評估網站流量、銷售線索（Leads）、轉換率及行銷投資報酬率（ROI）。 9. 規劃及管理全球產品推廣、展覽、論壇、研討會及相關行銷活動。 10. 與產品、業務及海外團隊合作，制定產品上市及市場推廣（Go-to-Market）策略。 11. 統籌銷售工具、行銷素材及產品溝通內容，協助業務拓展。 12. 領導行銷團隊，負責績效管理、人才培育及組織發展。 13. 管理行銷預算、外部代理商及供應商。 14. 定期提出行銷成效分析及策略改善建議，支援高階管理決策。 **資格條件** 1. 具備 10 年以上全球電子科技產業行銷相關經驗。 2. 曾任職具有全球市場的自有品牌電子科技公司。 3. 具備品牌策略、產品行銷、數位行銷及市場推廣整合經驗。 4. 具大型行銷團隊管理及跨部門協調能力。 5. 英文聽、說、讀、寫流利。 6. 熟悉國際 B2B 市場、全球品牌經營及產品上市策略。 7. 具備行銷數據分析及預算管理能力。 8. 能將客戶意見及市場分析轉化為產品與商業決策建議。 9. 具工業電腦（IPC）產業經驗者尤佳。 歡迎具全球電子科技品牌行銷及大型團隊領導經驗的資深主管，透過 LinkedIn 與 RGP 聯繫，進行保密職涯交流。
